summary.text: Gregory Lewis Swallow, a Republican, represents House District 7 (Houlton, Linneus, Ludlow, New Limerick and Oakfield, Aroostook County) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Houlton. The House profile lists membership on the Taxation Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 129th, 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives insurance marketing as the occupation and a B.A. in economics from UMO (1981).
It says Swallow is married, to Kristy.
